findings.evidence: Primary source (arXiv 2412.19437v2, pages 30-31, Table 6) names 'SWE-Bench Verified' (OpenAI, 2024d) and reports DeepSeek-V3 at 42.0, but contains no version or snapshot identifier. The artifact's benchmark_id asserts 'snapshot-2026-09-10' without any supporting source value.
findings.repair: Remove the unsupported 'snapshot-2026-09-10' version component from benchmark_id and match the source's identifier, or add primary evidence that documents the snapshot/version. If the snapshot is internal pipeline metadata, label it as such and do not present it as the benchmark version.

uncertainties: I could not recompute SHA-256 hashes or execute transport/qualification checks; I relied on the owner-provided per-row and source hashes and producer receipt.
The 'December 2024 update' wording in source_id is not verbatim in the paper; it is inferred from the arXiv date and could be imprecise.
missing_evidence: A source-supported benchmark version/snapshot for SWE-bench Verified; the packet contains only the name 'SWE-Bench Verified' without a version, while the artifact claims 'snapshot-2026-09-10'.
